text:
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT (severity=sev2) · tenant=ClearLeap · 1972500000 - SLA check 'tenant_response_p95' crossed threshold in us-east-1. Pager sent to eng-oncall.
Lee H: acked — I'm on it. seeing a big spike in retries tied to ClearLeap's batch worker floods.
Priya S: hopping in. are we sure it's tenant-scoped and not a control-plane regression? any other tenants affected?
Lee H: quick glance: only ClearLeap and their test namespace. other tenants steady. looks like a retry loop from their client caused CPU+latency on request-router -> kv-cache.
Jorge M: confirming infra metrics — host CPU on the serving pool jumped ~3x, GPU lanes stayed ok. suspect prefix cache thrash.
Kaitlyn P: pinging account team to ask ClearLeap to pause their job: @account-team can someone call them? mention they're hitting their SLA and generating noisy alerts.
alerts-bot: @account-team notified via escalation policy.
Lee H: immediate mitigation plan: 1) silence tenant-specific SLA pager for ClearLeap for 15m while we stabilize; 2) add debounce on tenant_response_p95 for that tenant; 3) create temp dashboard for ClearLeap traffic.
Priya S: agree. let's use an emergency runbook step to silence the noisy check instead of muting global rules. we should update check to be tenant-aware.
Lee H: executing: `/ops silence-check tenant_response_p95 --tenant=clearleap --duration=15m --reason="retry storm noisy pager"`
Oncall Bot: Command received. Check tenant_response_p95 for tenant=clearleap silenced until 1972500900 (15m).
Jorge M: while silence is active I'm throttling their request-ratelimit policy at the load-balancer layer for that tenant to 20rps to break the retry feedback loop. patching now.
Kaitlyn P: created temporary Grafana dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/clearleap-live — added panels: p95 latency, retries/sec, prefix-cache-miss-rate, request-rps by tenant.
Priya S: for post-incident cleanup we need to: - update alert to include a composite (p95 > X && retries/sec > Y) to reduce pPager noise - add a tenant_watchlist label so we can exclude known noisy tenants until they remediate - add a runbook note for tenant-driven retry storms.
Lee H: drafting the alert change. current rule: `expr: tenant_response_p95 > 1500` too sensitive when retries spike. propose new: ```yaml
alert: Tenant_Response_Degraded
expr: tenant_response_p95 > 1500 and tenant_retries_total_rate > 50
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: page
  owner: eng-oncall
annotations:
  summary: "tenant {{ $labels.tenant }} p95 >1.5s with high retries"
  runbook: "https://runbook.redwood.internal/tenant-retry-storms"
```
Jorge M: that looks good. also suggest adding `exclude_tenants: [clearleap]` as a temporary opt-out field for the next 24h if they promise remediation. we can implement as a watchlist in the alert manager.
Kaitlyn P: account team just confirmed ClearLeap will pause the job for 30m and open a ticket with root cause. I'll file the internal follow-up: RD-4281 (ClearLeap retry storm + SLA noise).
Lee H: handing off to Priya for postmortem & follow-up changes. I'm going to update the dashboards and push the alert patch to staging.
Priya S: taking over. next actions: 1) push alert rule to staging and monitor for false negatives 2) add composite rule and watchlist mechanic 3) schedule a 1hr postmortem with ClearLeap and infra folks (calendar invite).
Oncall Bot: Paging escalation resumed if further pages occur.
Kaitlyn P: quick note — update to SLA calc: we should consider using p95 over 5m windows excluding minutes with >30% retry amplification to avoid charging SLA breaches to customer for noisy retries. will add to RD-4281.
Lee H: good call. also we should add an automated alert-level change when a tenant's own telemetry shows >90% of requests are errors caused by client retries — that should lower severity to avoid noisy pages.
Priya S: agreed. I'll include that in the alert PR and link the test plan.
Jorge M: infra note: we're adding a metric tag `tenant_retry_throttle` to LB logs so we can prove throttling helped.
Lee H: closing the immediate loop — silence expires 15m from now; leaving a 30m watch. If metrics look stable by then we'll remove watchlist opt-out and revert alert to normal.
Kaitlyn P: thanks all. I'll update the customer comms template and CC support.
Priya S: post-incident checklist: - merge alert PR - create permanent dashboard for tenant-SLA anomalies - add runbook examples for tenant-specific suppression - review SLA calc with product.
Lee H: thanks team. reassigning thread to Priya for follow-up.
Priya S: noted — creating postmortem doc and action items. tagging @oncall-bot to close incident when done. :white_check_mark:
